decisions.reason: The burner component costs little to keep and supports the core gas radiant heater business, and with the firm growing there is no shortfall against aspirations that would prompt cutting it, though its low visibility leaves it somewhat exposed.

This multi-model electric infrared line is a flagship that fits the electrification direction, and after D was dropped it is the main electric offer, so it meets aspirations and is supported by slack.

The halogen heater rounds out the electric range for spot and outdoor heating, and without a reported performance shortfall there is no trigger for problemistic search, although the earlier withdrawal of D shows the electric range is being reviewed.
The hydrogen-capable dark heater is a strategic flagship already in real operation and central to the low-carbon direction, so the firm will use its slack to carry it while hydrogen demand develops.
